about: check-card.mjs spec for the 160 Scapes reference cards (the control run), generated once from the analysis markup. Staging per card: the same fields as references/README.md; sky_top picked by eye (COLOUR check 14). mask: whether the outline proposed by the hero mask was confirmed by eye («confirmed») or rejected («rejected»); hero_box: the hero box confirmed by eye, given where the mask was rejected (where it was confirmed, check-card.mjs takes the box from the mask).
